simple.meaning: שְׁקַעְרוּרָה (shᵉqaʻrûwrâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a depression.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 14:37. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁקַעְרוּרָה (H8258) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H8258. sheqaarurah [ שְׁקַעֲרוּרָה ] noun feminine depression, hollow (on formation see Ges § 55f ); — plural שְׁקַעֲרוּרֹת Lev 14:37 in wall.
